notes: The Summary's 'significantly increased' is the only inferential language, so it is recorded as an unnamed test with no named method. The NMNR rate is a surveillance indicator, not diagnostic accuracy, so no accuracy procedure is recorded. Percent changes are arithmetic and are not recorded as procedures.
view_issues: Abstract says the 2022 SIA was completed in 32 provinces, but Table 1 reports 34 (100%) completing it; the footnote says BIAN was in 32 of 34. The text also writes 'MCRV1' and 'MCRV2' where it elsewhere uses MRCV.
